a.text: Being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I want to explain why. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the operate-until-8 plan needs two storm-free rounds, so it gives each of us only about a 4% chance. I'd rather not hide this behind an 'operate' message. If you operate in round 1, I'll take 4. After that I commit to choosing operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I'll take nothing more. If we both take now, the split is random and we probably both end up short, so please consider operating. I'm open to a different fair proposal if you have one.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I told you, I'm taking 4 this round. From now on I'll choose operate every round and take nothing more, so the generator runs for you. Once the reserve reaches 4, take it all. I'm sorry this breaks our original plan. With the storm odds, I judged it the better choice, and I'll keep my commitment to help you fill your unit.
